an11.16:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati veḷuvagāmake.
an11.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pātaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena
an11.16:2.1: athakho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro yena kukkuṭārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
an11.16:2.2: kahaṃ nu kho bhante āyasmā ānando etarahi viharati
an11.16:2.3: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ bhante āyasmantaṃ ānandanti.
an11.16:2.4: eso gahapati āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati veḷuvagāmaketi.
an11.16:3.1: athakho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pātaliputte taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tiretvā yena vesāliveḷuvagāmako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an11.16:3.2: atthi nu kho bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
an11.16:3.3: atthi gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
an11.16:4.1: katamo pana bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātīti.
an11.16:4.2: idha gahapati bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an11.16:4.4: idaṃ kho paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ
an11.16:4.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
an11.16:4.6: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti
an11.16:4.7: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
an11.16:4.8: ayaṃ kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …
an11.16:5.5: idampi kho catutthaṃ jhānaṃ abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ
an11.16:5.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti

an11.16:5.9: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati

an11.16:9.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an11.16:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an11.16:9.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṃkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti
an11.16:9.6: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti

an11.16:10.1: evaṃ vutte dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an11.16:10.2: seyyathāpi bhante ānanda puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya
an11.16:10.3: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ alatthaṃ savanāya
an11.16:10.4: seyyathāpi bhante purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekamekena dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ
an11.16:10.5: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekamekena amatadvārena sakkuṇissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ
an11.16:10.6: ime hi nāma bhante aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti
an11.16:10.7: kiṃ panāhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ karissāmīti
an11.16:11.1: athakho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro vesālikañca pātaliputtakañca bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi
an11.16:11.2: ekamekañca bhikkhuṃ paccekadussayugena acchādesi āyasmantañca ānandaṃ ticīvarena
an11.16:11.3: āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasataṃ vihāraṃ kārāpesīti. 17
